jira-google-calendar.metaDescription: Connect Jira and Google Calendar with GAIA. Automatically add Jira sprint start and end dates, issue due dates, and release milestones to Google Calendar so engineering deadlines are always visible alongside the rest of your schedule.
jira-google-calendar.intro:
Jira knows when sprints start and end, when issues are due, and when releases are planned. Google Calendar is where engineers and managers live for time management. But sprint dates in Jira do not appear in Google Calendar automatically, meaning engineers have to check two places to understand their upcoming obligations and managers have to manually create calendar events for milestones they can see in Jira.

GAIA connects Jira and Google Calendar so every sprint, due date, and release milestone in Jira appears automatically as a calendar event. Engineers see their engineering deadlines alongside meetings and personal events without switching tools. Managers get calendar reminders for sprint reviews and release dates without manually creating events.

This integration is particularly useful for engineering managers juggling multiple Jira projects who want a single calendar view of all sprint timelines, and for engineers who use Google Calendar as their primary planning tool and want Jira obligations to surface there naturally.

useCases.title: Add Jira sprint start and end dates to Google Calendar
useCases.description: When a new Jira sprint is created, GAIA creates a Google Calendar event spanning the sprint dates with the sprint name, project, and a link to the Jira sprint board so the team sees sprint boundaries in their calendars automatically.

useCases.title: Create calendar events for Jira issue due dates
useCases.description: When a Jira issue assigned to you receives a due date, GAIA creates a Google Calendar reminder event on that date so engineering deadlines appear alongside meetings and personal commitments in a single view.

useCases.title: Add Jira release milestones to the team calendar
useCases.description: When a Jira version is created with a release date, GAIA adds a milestone event to the shared engineering Google Calendar so the entire team sees upcoming release dates without checking the Jira releases page.

useCases.title: Update calendar events when Jira dates change
useCases.description: When a Jira sprint is extended or an issue due date is pushed, GAIA updates the corresponding Google Calendar event automatically so calendar dates always reflect the current Jira schedule without manual corrections.

useCases.title: Schedule sprint ceremonies from Jira sprint dates
useCases.description: When a Jira sprint is created, GAIA schedules recurring Google Calendar invites for sprint planning, daily standup, sprint review, and retrospective based on the sprint dates and the team's configured ceremony schedule.

faqs.question: Does GAIA create individual calendar events for every Jira issue due date or only sprints?
faqs.answer: Both are configurable. You can sync sprint dates only, issue due dates only, or both. For issue due dates, you can filter by assignee so only issues assigned to each team member create events on their personal calendar.

faqs.question: What happens to Google Calendar events when a Jira sprint is deleted?
faqs.answer: GAIA deletes or cancels the corresponding Google Calendar event when a Jira sprint is deleted. If the sprint is renamed or its dates are changed, GAIA updates the calendar event to match.

faqs.question: Can GAIA add Jira issue due date reminders to a shared team calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to write to a shared Google Calendar that all team members subscribe to. This gives the team a unified view of all upcoming Jira deadlines without each member needing personal calendar sync enabled.
O GAIA não abre arquivos de design: não associa frames por nome. Ele vincula issues e designs pelas URLs que você dá, e pesquisa issues cujo texto contenha um link ou nome de arquivo específico.
faqs.question: Como o GAIA identifica qual frame pertence a qual ticket?

faqs.answer: A prévia vem do app do Marketplace, não do GAIA. O GAIA coloca a URL de design na issue e, com o app instalado, a issue mostra a prévia do design.
faqs.question: O GAIA embute prévias de design dentro dos tickets?

faqs.answer: O GAIA não lê arquivos de design: não enxerga branches nem merges. Se você der a ele um link de branch, ele usa esse link na issue; após um merge, você pode pedir para trocar o link pelo arquivo principal.
faqs.question: O GAIA aceita fluxos de branching de design?

faqs.answer: Instale o app do Marketplace pelo Atlassian Marketplace (um admin pode precisar aprovar), conecte sua conta de design quando o app pedir e cole um link de arquivo ou frame numa issue para mostrar o design.
faqs.question: Como adiciono o Figma ao Jira?

faqs.answer: Sim. O editor de design tem plugins de Dev Mode e widgets para FigJam que mostram e vinculam issues dentro de um arquivo. Procure o rastreador pelo nome ali. O GAIA atua só no lado do rastreador.
faqs.question: Existe plugin para conectar os dois?

faqs.answer: Não diretamente. O GAIA não tem conexão com o editor de design: não detecta mudanças de design. Ele mantém o lado dos tickets organizado (links, status, comentários, alertas) por agenda, enquanto o app do Marketplace mantém a prévia de design na issue atual.

Para conectar os dois, instale o app Figma for Jira pelo Atlassian Marketplace. Com ele, você cola um link de arquivo ou frame numa issue e a issue mostra uma prévia viva do design. jira-discord.tagline: Post Jira issue updates to Discord dev channels automatically
jira-discord.metaTitle: Jira + Discord Integration - Engineering Updates in Your Dev Server
jira-discord.metaDescription: Connect Jira and Discord with GAIA. Automatically post Jira ticket updates, sprint summaries, and blocker alerts to your Discord engineering channels so the team stays informed without monitoring Jira.
jira-discord.intro:
Engineering teams that use Discord as their primary communication hub often find that Jira activity stays invisible in their day-to-day chat. A critical bug is created in Jira but nobody in Discord knows until the next standup. A sprint closes with impressive velocity but the team never sees a summary. Engineers have to tab over to Jira just to find out if their PR review is unblocking the issue they care about.

GAIA brings Jira into Discord by routing the right events to the right channels automatically. Sprint summaries land in the engineering channel at the end of every sprint. Critical bugs trigger immediate alerts. Assigned issues notify engineers in DMs. Teams can also create and update Jira tickets with Discord commands without leaving their chat environment.

This integration is most impactful for remote engineering teams who run Discord as their virtual office and want Jira activity to flow into their existing communication rhythm rather than requiring constant tool switching.

useCases.title: Post sprint summaries to the engineering channel
useCases.description: When a Jira sprint closes, GAIA posts a formatted summary to the designated Discord channel including stories completed, velocity, carry-over issues, and top contributors so the team celebrates progress and understands what carried forward.

useCases.title: Alert the team to new critical bugs
useCases.description: When a Jira issue of type Bug is created or upgraded to Critical priority, GAIA immediately posts an alert to the engineering Discord channel with the bug title, reporter, affected component, and link so the team can respond quickly.

useCases.title: DM engineers when Jira issues are assigned
useCases.description: When a Jira issue is assigned to an engineer, GAIA sends them a Discord DM with the issue summary, priority, sprint, and a direct Jira link so they are notified in the tool they are already using.

useCases.title: Post blocker notifications to the leads channel
useCases.description: When a Jira story transitions to Blocked, GAIA posts a structured notification to the team leads Discord channel identifying the blocking dependency and the affected engineer so resolution can be coordinated immediately.

useCases.title: Create Jira tickets from Discord slash commands
useCases.description: Engineers can type a GAIA slash command in Discord to create a new Jira ticket without leaving the chat. GAIA collects the issue type, summary, and priority through a short Discord prompt and creates the ticket, posting the confirmation back to the channel.

howItWorks.step: Connect Jira and Discord to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Jira project and invite the GAIA bot to your Discord server. Map Jira projects and issue types to Discord channels during setup.

howItWorks.description: Choose which Jira events generate Discord messages, which channels or users should receive each event type, and the format of notification embeds.

faqs.question: Can GAIA route Jira notifications from different projects to different Discord channels?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure separate channel routing rules for each Jira project. For example, mobile Jira tickets go to #mobile-dev and backend tickets go to #backend-dev. You can also route by issue type or priority regardless of project.

faqs.question: How does GAIA match Discord users to Jira users for DM notifications?
faqs.answer: During setup you provide a mapping of Jira usernames to Discord user IDs. GAIA uses this mapping to send direct messages to the correct Discord user when their Jira account receives an assignment.

faqs.question: Can GAIA avoid posting every minor Jira event and keep Discord signal quality high?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA's event filter configuration is very granular. Most teams set it to notify only on issue creation, status transitions to specific states, priority escalations, and sprint boundaries. Routine field edits and comment additions are excluded by default.

faqs.question: O GAIA anexa arquivos de drives compartilhados, não só do Drive pessoal?

faqs.answer: URLs de documentos são estáveis e não mudam quando um arquivo passa de pasta. Links existentes continuam válidos após movimentações. O GAIA registra o evento de movimentação para que você tenha um registro de onde o documento mora.

jira-drive.intro:
Cada épico do Jira tem documentação que mora em algum lugar do Google Drive: o documento de requisitos de produto, o doc de design técnico, o e-mail de aprovação de stakeholders, as notas pós-lançamento. Mas achar e anexar esses documentos ao épico certo é trabalho manual que muitas vezes não acontece, deixando engenheiros fuçando pastas toda vez que precisam de contexto.

O GAIA constrói e mantém o vínculo entre documentos e épicos automaticamente. Quando um documento de requisitos de produto é criado com um nome correspondente, o GAIA o anexa ao épico correspondente. Quando um incidente é resolvido no Jira, o GAIA cria um documento de post-mortem no Drive. O sistema de documentação e o de acompanhamento ficam conectados sem ninguém gerenciar a relação à mão.

Essa integração reduz o custo de reunir contexto que atrasa engenheiros no início de cada tarefa e garante que a lógica por trás das decisões de engenharia esteja sempre acessível da issue onde o trabalho é acompanhado.

jira-hubspot.intro:
Bugs relatados por clientes e registrados no HubSpot precisam chegar à engenharia no Jira, mas a passagem é quase sempre manual. Um representante de suporte registra um bug, alguém o lê, decide que cabe à engenharia, cria o ticket e verifica periodicamente para atualizar o CRM quando a engenharia resolve. Essa cadeia é lenta, inconsistente e depende de pessoas lembrarem de fechar o ciclo.

O GAIA automatiza o caminho do relato ao ticket e de volta. Quando um bug de cliente é registrado no HubSpot e atende aos seus critérios configurados, o GAIA cria um ticket no Jira com o contexto total do cliente anexado. Conforme o ticket avança, o GAIA atualiza o ticket de suporte original. Quando a engenharia resolve o bug, o GAIA avisa o dono da conta no CRM para que ele comunique a correção ao cliente.

Essa integração é impactante para SaaS B2B em que bugs relatados por clientes têm implicações diretas de receita e fechar o ciclo com o cliente exige coordenação entre sucesso do cliente, engenharia e vendas.

linear-jira.tagline: Sync Linear and Jira so modern and enterprise dev teams stay aligned
linear-jira.metaTitle: Linear + Jira Integration - Cross-Team Issue Sync
linear-jira.metaDescription: Automate Linear and Jira with GAIA. Sync issues between Linear and Jira, keep cross-team projects aligned, and eliminate friction managing work across two engineering tools.
linear-jira.intro:
Modern product teams often adopt Linear for its speed and developer-friendly UX, while enterprise counterparts or client organizations remain on Jira. The resulting split creates a synchronization burden: issues created in one tool must be manually mirrored in the other, status updates diverge, and neither side has reliable visibility into the other's progress.

GAIA eliminates that burden by keeping Linear and Jira in continuous sync. When an issue is created in Linear, GAIA can open the corresponding Jira ticket automatically. When a Jira issue changes status, GAIA updates the Linear counterpart. Sprint data flows between both platforms so managers in either tool see accurate progress without manual reconciliation.

This integration is especially valuable for agencies and consultancies that run internal work in Linear but must report progress through a client's Jira instance, and for companies mid-migration from Jira to Linear who need both systems live during the transition.

useCases.title: Bidirectional issue sync
useCases.description: GAIA mirrors issues created in Linear to Jira and vice versa, including title, description, priority, and assignee, so both systems always reflect the same source of truth.

useCases.title: Status change propagation
useCases.description: When an engineer moves a Linear issue to In Review or Done, GAIA updates the corresponding Jira ticket's status automatically, keeping project managers in Jira informed without manual updates.

useCases.title: Sprint planning across tools
useCases.description: GAIA reads Linear cycle data and creates or updates the matching Jira sprint so sprint start dates, end dates, and issue assignments stay consistent across both platforms.

useCases.title: GitHub PR linking in both tools
useCases.description: When a pull request referencing a Linear issue is opened, GAIA attaches the PR link to both the Linear issue and the corresponding Jira ticket so reviewers in either tool have full context.

useCases.title: Cross-team progress reporting
useCases.description: GAIA generates a unified progress report aggregating Linear and Jira data, giving leadership a single view of delivery status regardless of which tool each team uses.

howItWorks.step: Connect Linear and Jira to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Linear workspace and Jira instance in GAIA's integration settings. GAIA uses OAuth for Linear and API tokens for Jira, keeping your credentials secure.

howItWorks.step: Map projects and issue fields
howItWorks.description: Tell GAIA which Linear teams map to which Jira projects, and how fields like priority, status, and labels should translate between the two systems.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps both systems in sync automatically
howItWorks.description: Once configured, GAIA monitors both platforms for changes and propagates updates in real time. You can adjust mapping rules anytime using natural language commands.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync only specific Linear teams to Jira?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can scope the sync to specific Linear teams and Jira projects. For example, you might sync only your platform team's Linear issues to a client's Jira board while keeping other teams' work private.

faqs.question: What happens if an issue is updated in both tools simultaneously?
faqs.answer: GAIA uses a last-write-wins strategy by default and flags conflicts for your review. You can configure which tool is treated as the master source of truth for specific fields.

faqs.question: Does GAIA sync comments and attachments between Linear and Jira?
faqs.answer: GAIA can sync comments and file attachments between the two tools. This is configurable — some teams prefer to sync only status and assignee changes to avoid comment noise.

faqs.question: Is this useful during a Jira-to-Linear migration?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can run both systems in parallel during a migration period, syncing issues bidirectionally so neither team loses continuity while the organization transitions fully to Linear.

faqs.question: O GAIA grava em campos padrão ou personalizados?

linear-salesforce.intro:
Equipes de vendas enterprise dependem do Salesforce para gerenciar oportunidades e casos de clientes, enquanto equipes de engenharia constroem e entregam no Linear. Quando um bug que bloqueia um cliente ou um recurso que fecha um negócio está no backlog da engenharia, o CRM não enxerga seu progresso — e executivos de contas ficam cobrando updates de engenharia manualmente antes de calls com clientes.

O GAIA conecta os dois para que equipes voltadas ao cliente tenham sempre o status correto da engenharia. Casos do Salesforce vinculados a bugs conhecidos recebem updates automáticos de progresso. Pedidos de recurso anexados a oportunidades de alto valor são acompanhados como issues no Linear com contexto de receita embutido. Quando a engenharia entrega, os registros relacionados atualizam sozinhos.

Para empresas de software enterprise com engenharia de vendas e sucesso do cliente dedicados, essa integração elimina uma categoria inteira de trabalho interno de coordenação que hoje consome horas toda semana.

linear-teams.intro:
Organizações que padronizaram o Microsoft Teams para comunicação costumam ter equipes de engenharia usando o Linear para acompanhar issues. Sem integração, updates de engenharia ficam no rastreador enquanto o resto da organização conversa no chat — criando um vão de visibilidade que força stakeholders a pedir updates manuais de status o tempo todo.

O GAIA conecta os dois para que o progresso da engenharia fique visível à organização inteira no app de chat que ela já usa. Atribuições de issues, updates de sprint, merges de PR e escalonamentos aparecem nos canais relevantes como avisos formatados. Não engenheiros perguntam ao GAIA no Teams pelo status de qualquer projeto do Linear sem precisar de conta.

Para equipes enterprise rodando no Microsoft 365, essa integração se encaixa naturalmente num fluxo centrado em chat e elimina a necessidade de reuniões separadas de status de projeto.

linear-loom.intro:
Descrições em texto em issues do Linear muitas vezes não dão conta de bugs complexos ou feedbacks sutis de recurso. Uma gravação de dez segundos no Loom de um bug de UI transmite mais que três parágrafos de descrição escrita — mas anexar essa gravação à issue certa exige lembrar o número da issue, abrir o Linear e colar manualmente o link do vídeo.

O GAIA conecta os dois. Quando uma gravação do Loom é criada com uma etiqueta ou convenção de título específica, o GAIA identifica a issue relevante e anexa o vídeo automaticamente. Gravações de bug geram issues novas com o vídeo embutido. Vídeos de update de sprint viram comentários em todas as issues concluídas naquela semana.

Para equipes remotas e async-first de dev, essa integração cria uma camada mais rica de comunicação assíncrona sobre o fluxo estruturado de issues — combinando a precisão do rastreio com a clareza da comunicação em vídeo.

jira-asana.metaDescription: Automate Jira and Asana with GAIA. Sync Jira tickets with Asana tasks, keep product and engineering aligned, and eliminate manual status updates between project management tools.
jira-asana.intro:
Product teams track work in Asana while engineering teams work in Jira. The gap between them is where projects slow down — product managers create Asana tasks that need corresponding Jira tickets, status updates must be manually mirrored across both tools, and neither side has full visibility into the other.

GAIA synchronizes Jira and Asana so the right information is in both places without double entry. Asana tasks create Jira tickets. Jira status changes update Asana. Product managers see engineering progress in Asana. Engineers see product context in Jira. Both teams work in their preferred tool while GAIA keeps them aligned.

For enterprise product organizations running structured program management in Asana alongside Jira-based engineering sprints, this integration is the connective tissue that removes weekly sync meetings and manual spreadsheet updates from the delivery process.

useCases.title: Feature task to Jira ticket
useCases.description: When a product manager creates a feature task in Asana and marks it engineering-ready, GAIA opens a corresponding Jira story in the appropriate project, pre-filled with acceptance criteria from the Asana task.

useCases.title: Jira sprint status in Asana timelines
useCases.description: As engineers progress Jira tickets through the sprint, GAIA reflects those status changes on the Asana task so project timelines and program-level reports stay accurate automatically.

useCases.title: Epic-to-portfolio alignment
useCases.description: GAIA maps Jira epics to Asana portfolios, keeping high-level roadmap items synchronized so executive stakeholders can track progress at the portfolio level without Jira access.

useCases.title: Bug escalation from Asana to Jira
useCases.description: When a bug is flagged in Asana during UAT or customer feedback review, GAIA creates a prioritized Jira bug ticket and routes it to the on-call engineering team for triage.

useCases.title: Sprint completion milestone updates
useCases.description: When a Jira sprint closes, GAIA marks the corresponding Asana milestone complete and posts a sprint summary to the project feed so stakeholders see delivery confirmation without attending sprint review.

faqs.question: Does GAIA sync every Asana task to Jira?
faqs.answer: Only tasks you configure for sync. You can filter by Asana project, section, tag, or custom field so only engineering-ready tasks generate Jira tickets.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync Jira epics and sub-tasks to Asana?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can map Jira epics to Asana projects or milestones, and Jira sub-tasks to Asana subtasks. The hierarchy mapping is configurable to fit your team's structure.

faqs.question: What happens when a Jira ticket is resolved?
faqs.answer: When a Jira ticket is marked Done or Closed, GAIA updates the linked Asana task status accordingly. You can configure whether this marks the task complete or simply updates a status custom field.

faqs.question: Can we use this during a migration from Jira to Asana?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many teams use this integration during a phased migration, running Jira and Asana in parallel with GAIA keeping them in sync until the team is fully on Asana.

jira-salesforce.intro:
Empresas de software enterprise gerenciam relacionamentos com clientes no Salesforce e operações de engenharia no Jira. Quando um cliente relata um bug crítico ou pede um recurso, a informação precisa viajar do CRM ao rastreador para ação da engenharia — e voltar quando a correção entra em produção. Sem automação, essa jornada é manual, lenta e pouco confiável.

O GAIA conecta os dois para que equipes voltadas ao cliente saibam sempre o status do trabalho de engenharia que afeta suas contas. Casos do Salesforce escalados como bugs geram tickets no Jira automaticamente. Resoluções de tickets atualizam status de casos. Oportunidades de alto valor com dependências de engenharia mostram o status do ticket direto no registro da oportunidade.

Para SaaS B2B enterprise em que a confiança do cliente depende de comunicação confiável sobre cronogramas de engenharia, essa integração garante que cada questão que afeta clientes seja acompanhada de ponta a ponta nos dois sistemas.

jira-zoom.intro:
Equipes enterprise de engenharia rodam suas cerimônias de sprint — planning, refinamento, dailies, retrospectivas — no Zoom. Cada reunião gera ações, decisões e updates de issues que precisam cair no Jira. Sem automação, um anotador dedicado transcreve manualmente resultados em tickets após cada call, um processo lento, incompleto e insustentável em escala.

O GAIA conecta os dois para que resultados de reunião virem tickets automaticamente. Calls de planning geram tickets novos para itens assumidos. Dailies com bloqueios sinalizados criam ou atualizam impedimentos. Ações de retrospectiva caem no backlog da equipe com as etiquetas adequadas. Resumos de reunião vão para tickets relevantes para rastreabilidade.

Para equipes enterprise distribuídas em que a maior parte da coordenação entre equipes acontece por vídeo, cada decisão tomada numa call é capturada e acompanhada no Jira.

jira-teams.intro:
O Microsoft Teams é o padrão enterprise de comunicação para organizações no Microsoft 365, e o Jira é o rastreador de issues enterprise preferido de equipes de software. Apesar de usados juntos com frequência, manter todos informados do progresso exige ou publicação manual ou um conector nativo limitado, sem formatação contextual nem direcionamento inteligente.

O GAIA oferece uma conexão mais rica entre os dois. Resumos de sprint, alertas de bloqueio, avisos de release e escalonamentos de issues prioritárias chegam aos canais certos com formatação estruturada e legível. Stakeholders não técnicos consultam o GAIA no Teams sobre status de projeto sem precisar de licença do Jira. Gerentes de engenharia recebem resumos personalizados do progresso de sprint da equipe.

Para grandes enterprises em que o chat é o hub operacional, os dados de issues chegam às pessoas certas nos canais certos com o contexto certo — automaticamente.

faqs.answer: Sim. O GAIA sincroniza épicos, sprints e versões em tabelas separadas ou como registros vinculados, dando uma visão relacional de banco de dados da sua estrutura inteira de projeto.
faqs.question: O GAIA sincroniza épicos e sprints do Jira além de issues individuais?

faqs.answer: A gravação seletiva de volta funciona. Você pode configurar colunas específicas (como responsável ou prioridade) para empurrar updates de volta ao ticket quando mudadas no registro, mantendo outros campos só de leitura.
faqs.question: Usuários do Airtable atualizam tickets editando registros?

faqs.answer: Por padrão, o GAIA sincroniza quase em tempo real para eventos de alto sinal (mudanças de status, atribuições, issues novas) e por agenda periódica para dados em massa como métricas de velocidade de sprint.
faqs.question: Com que frequência o GAIA sincroniza dados entre os dois?

faqs.answer: Sim. O GAIA sincroniza um subconjunto filtrado de issues (ex.: issues marcadas como itens públicos de roadmap) com uma base configurada para compartilhamento público, dando um roadmap vivo sem updates manuais.
faqs.question: Dá para montar um roadmap público com isso?

howItWorks.description: Autentique as duas contas nas configurações do GAIA. Defina a base e a tabela onde os dados de issues devem ser sincronizados.

howItWorks.description: Defina o mapeamento entre campos de issue e colunas de tabela. O GAIA traz um esquema padrão cobrindo campos padrão e aceita mapeamento de campos personalizados para configurações avançadas.
howItWorks.step: Mapeie campos do Jira para colunas do Airtable

howItWorks.description: O GAIA monitora mudanças e atualiza registros em tempo real. Submissões de formulário também são monitoradas e convertidas em issues numa agenda configurável.
howItWorks.step: O GAIA mantém registros atuais com dados vivos

jira-airtable.intro:
Equipes de operações, gestão de programas e negócios adoram o Airtable por suas visões flexíveis, fórmulas e relatórios. Equipes de engenharia dependem do Jira para gestão de sprints, acompanhamento e planning de releases. Quando esses grupos precisam colaborar em roadmaps, recursos ou relatórios executivos, o vão de dados entre os dois força exportações manuais e planilhas defasadas.

O GAIA fecha esse vão em tempo real. Issues, épicos, sprints e dados de versão fluem automaticamente para registros do Airtable, dando às equipes de negócio as visões de banco de que precisam sem licença do Jira. Formulários de entrada geram tickets automaticamente. Painéis executivos montados nesses registros puxam velocidade viva de sprint e dados de burn-down.

Para organizações enterprise que rodam um hub operacional multifuncional no Airtable, essa integração torna os dados de entrega de engenharia cidadãos de primeira classe em cada relatório operacional.

jira-airtable.metaDescription: Sincronize issues do Jira com registros do Airtable e envie formulários de entrada ao backlog. O GAIA monta visões de roadmap. Veja como configurar.

useCases.description: O GAIA sincroniza tickets marcados com identificadores de clientes na base e dispara alertas quando se aproximam ou estouram limites de SLA, com base em regras de automação da base.

faqs.answer: Sim. Se o título de um vídeo inclui uma frase de gatilho como “Bug:” ou “Issue:”, o GAIA cria um ticket novo usando o título do vídeo como resumo e embute o link na descrição.
faqs.question: O GAIA cria um ticket no Jira de uma gravação do Loom sem issue prévia?

faqs.answer: Sim. O GAIA processa a transcrição para extrair uma descrição, passos de reprodução e critérios de aceite, usando esse conteúdo nos campos Descrição e Comentários do ticket.
faqs.question: O GAIA usa a transcrição para preencher campos do ticket?

faqs.answer: Não necessariamente. Gravações compartilhadas via link público ou de workspace podem ser vistas por quem tem o link. O GAIA anexa vídeos pelo link compartilhado para que espectadores do ticket os assistam sem login, se o vídeo estiver com acesso por link.
faqs.question: Quem assiste precisa de conta para abrir vídeos anexados?

faqs.answer: Sim. O GAIA anexa links a histórias, épicos, tarefas, subtarefas e bugs. Isso é útil para gravações de QA correspondentes a critérios de aceite específicos acompanhados como subtarefas.
faqs.question: O GAIA anexa vídeos a subtarefas?

howItWorks.description: Autentique sua instância do Jira e seu workspace nas configurações do GAIA. O GAIA usa a API do Loom para monitorar gravações novas e acessar transcrições de vídeo.

howItWorks.description: Diga ao GAIA como associar gravações a tickets: por ID de issue no título do vídeo, por pasta ou por análise de conteúdo da transcrição. Defina frases de gatilho para criar tickets novos.

howItWorks.description: Quando uma gravação nova corresponde às suas regras, o GAIA a anexa ao ticket correto ou cria um novo, avisando o membro relevante da equipe com um link para o vídeo e o ticket.

jira-loom.intro:
Tickets que descrevem bugs complexos ou requisitos sutis só em texto costumam gerar conversas de esclarecimento que atrasam a resolução. Uma gravação breve no Loom demonstrando um bug ou percorrendo um requisito de recurso comunica em segundos o que parágrafos de texto penam para transmitir — mas conectar essa gravação ao ticket certo do Jira exige esforço manual.

O GAIA automatiza o vínculo entre os dois. Gravações de bug criam tickets com o vídeo embutido. Gravações que citam um ID de issue são anexadas automaticamente àquele ticket como comentário. Gravações de demo de sprint vão para as issues concluídas que cobrem, criando uma trilha permanente de auditoria em vídeo dos recursos entregues.

Para equipes enterprise gerenciando backlogs complexos em que a clareza da issue afeta direto a velocidade de resolução, o contexto em vídeo reduz drasticamente o ciclo de esclarecimentos e mantém a colaboração assíncrona produtiva.

updates assíncronos de engenharia no Jira
gravação de demo de sprint no Jira

useCases.description: Durante a resposta a incidentes, engenheiros gravam walkthroughs da questão e das etapas de correção. O GAIA anexa essas gravações ao ticket do incidente como referência de post-mortem.

faqs.answer: Não. O GAIA usa acesso de API só de leitura para monitorar eventos e dados de assinatura. Ele nunca inicia cobranças, reembolsos nem transações financeiras.
faqs.question: O GAIA precisa de acesso de escrita à conta da Stripe?

faqs.answer: Sim. O GAIA aplica limites e janelas de tempo configuráveis para distinguir um soluço temporário de gateway de uma falha sistêmica de cobrança. Só eventos acima dos seus limites geram tickets.
faqs.question: O GAIA distingue erros transitórios de problemas sistêmicos?

faqs.answer: O GAIA correlaciona o momento de um pico de erros com tickets recentemente concluídos ou deploys de sprint, mostrando prováveis candidatos a causa raiz no ticket de incidente.
faqs.question: O GAIA correlaciona picos de erro com deploys recentes?

faqs.answer: O GAIA monitora o fluxo de eventos continuamente. Se uma condição de erro some, o GAIA comenta no ticket registrando a resolução e sugere fechar ou rebaixar sua prioridade.
faqs.question: E se uma questão de cobrança se resolve antes de a engenharia investigar?

howItWorks.description: Dê ao GAIA uma chave de API restrita e só de leitura da Stripe e autentique sua instância do Jira. Configure quais tipos de evento e limites disparam a criação de tickets.
howItWorks.step: Conecte o Jira e o Stripe ao GAIA

howItWorks.description: Defina as condições de evento que justificam tickets: taxas de falha, limites de MRR, códigos de erro específicos, e mapeie-os para projetos, tipos de issue e níveis de prioridade.
howItWorks.step: Defina limites de receita e direcionamento de tickets

howItWorks.description: O GAIA escuta os eventos configurados e cria ou atualiza tickets de acordo, anotando cada um com contexto de receita para que sua equipe priorize e resolva questões de cobrança com eficiência.
howItWorks.step: O GAIA monitora eventos de cobrança e gerencia tickets no automático

jira-stripe.intro:
Para SaaS enterprise, a Stripe é o motor de receita e o Jira é o centro de comando da engenharia. Quando a Stripe relata falhas de pagamento, erros de webhook ou anomalias de assinatura, esses eventos exigem investigação imediata da engenharia — mas o caminho de um alerta no painel a um ticket bem registrado e priorizado raramente é automatizado.

O GAIA conecta os dois para que eventos críticos de receita gerem automaticamente tickets de engenharia com o contexto necessário para resolução rápida. Picos de falha de pagamento criam bugs urgentes com códigos de erro e dados de planos afetados. Falhas de entrega de webhook viram tarefas com instruções de replay. Avisos de descontinuação de API criam tickets com prazos e referências de código. Engenheiros priorizam trabalho de cobrança com dados completos de impacto de receita visíveis na issue.

Para empresas em que a confiabilidade de cobrança é uma métrica de conselho, anomalias de cobrança nunca esperam na caixa de alguém antes de chegar à equipe de engenharia.

asana-clickup.tagline: Bridge Asana and ClickUp when teams use both platforms
asana-clickup.metaTitle: Integração Asana + ClickUp: tarefas sincronizadas nas duas
asana-clickup.metaDescription: Asana + ClickUp no GAIA: Pare de duplicar trabalho: tarefas, status e prazos ficam sincronizados e todos veem dados corretos na ferramenta que preferirem.
asana-clickup.intro:
Many growing organizations run Asana and ClickUp simultaneously — one team adopted Asana early, another migrated to ClickUp, and now both coexist without talking to each other. The result is duplicated task entry, mismatched statuses, and project leads who spend hours reconciling two separate sources of truth.

GAIA eliminates the manual overhead of managing projects across both platforms. When a task is created or updated in Asana, GAIA mirrors the change in ClickUp and vice versa, keeping assignees, due dates, and completion statuses consistent. Teams can continue using their preferred tool while leadership gets a consolidated view of project health.

This integration is especially valuable during platform migrations, when departments have different tool preferences, or when client-facing projects need to live in one system while internal execution happens in another.

useCases.title: Mirror task creation across platforms
useCases.description: When a new task is created in Asana with an assigned team member and due date, GAIA automatically creates a corresponding task in ClickUp so both platforms reflect the same work without manual duplication.

useCases.title: Sync task completion status bidirectionally
useCases.description: When a task is marked complete in either Asana or ClickUp, GAIA updates the counterpart record immediately, preventing stale open items from cluttering project views in either tool.

useCases.title: Unified cross-team reporting
useCases.description: GAIA aggregates task data from both Asana and ClickUp to generate a single weekly status report, giving leadership consistent project visibility without requiring everyone to switch tools.

useCases.title: Escalate blockers between systems
useCases.description: When a task in ClickUp is flagged as blocked, GAIA creates a dependency flag on the linked Asana task so project managers in both systems are aware and can intervene quickly.

useCases.title: Deadline drift alerts
useCases.description: GAIA monitors due dates across both platforms and alerts the team when a task's deadline in one system does not match the other, preventing schedule confusion before it becomes a delivery issue.

howItWorks.step: Connect both workspaces to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Asana workspace and your ClickUp workspace. GAIA maps projects and lists between the two platforms so it knows which items correspond to each other.

howItWorks.step: Define sync rules and field mappings
howItWorks.description: Tell GAIA which Asana projects should sync with which ClickUp lists, and configure how fields map between them — assignees, priorities, due dates, and custom fields.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps both platforms current
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both systems for changes and propagates updates bidirectionally so teams in each platform always see current, accurate task data.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle a one-time migration from Asana to ClickUp?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can bulk-read all tasks from an Asana project and create corresponding tasks in a ClickUp list, preserving titles, descriptions, assignees, and due dates. After migration you can turn off the sync or keep it active for a transition period.

faqs.question: What happens if a task is edited in both platforms simultaneously?
faqs.answer: GAIA applies a last-write-wins rule by default and flags the conflict in a designated Slack channel or email digest so a human can review. You can also configure one platform to always be the system of record.

faqs.question: Do custom fields in ClickUp sync with custom fields in Asana?
faqs.answer: GAIA supports mapping custom fields by name or type. If field names differ between platforms, you can define explicit mappings during setup. Fields without a counterpart are logged but not discarded.

asana-trello.tagline: Migrate or sync tasks between Asana projects and Trello boards
asana-trello.metaTitle: Integração Asana + Trello: tarefas e quadros sem esforço
asana-trello.metaDescription: Asana + Trello no GAIA: Conecte projetos e quadros, sincronize tarefas e mova cards quando o status mudar, sem entrada manual de dados.
asana-trello.intro:
Asana and Trello approach project management differently — Asana with structured task hierarchies and timelines, Trello with visual Kanban boards — but many teams rely on both. Client-facing work might live in Trello for its simplicity while internal project tracking uses Asana's more powerful features. Without automation, teams must update both tools manually, creating delays and inconsistencies.

GAIA connects Asana and Trello so tasks flow between them automatically. New Asana tasks can become Trello cards, Trello card movements can update Asana task statuses, and deadlines stay consistent across both platforms. Teams can collaborate in their preferred interface while the underlying data stays unified.

This integration is ideal for agencies managing client boards in Trello while tracking internal project timelines in Asana, and for teams transitioning between the two tools who need a reliable migration path.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from new Asana tasks
useCases.description: When a task is added to an Asana project, GAIA automatically creates a corresponding Trello card in the appropriate list, complete with the task title, description, due date, and assignee.

useCases.title: Sync Trello card moves back to Asana
useCases.description: When a Trello card moves from In Progress to Done, GAIA marks the linked Asana task as complete, keeping both tools consistent without requiring team members to update two systems.

useCases.title: Bulk migrate projects from Asana to Trello
useCases.description: GAIA reads all tasks in an Asana project and creates a fully populated Trello board with lists mapped to Asana sections, making platform transitions seamless and data-complete.

useCases.title: Deadline synchronization
useCases.description: GAIA monitors due dates in both platforms and alerts the team when dates diverge, ensuring that deadline changes made in one tool are reflected in the other before they cause scheduling conflicts.

useCases.title: Client board updates from internal tracking
useCases.description: When internal Asana milestones are reached, GAIA updates the corresponding Trello card in the client-facing board, giving clients real-time progress visibility without exposing internal project details.

howItWorks.step: Authorize Asana and Trello in GAIA
howItWorks.description: Connect your Asana workspace and Trello account to GAIA. GAIA maps Asana projects to Trello boards and Asana sections to Trello lists based on your configuration.

howItWorks.step: Set sync direction and field mappings
howItWorks.description: Choose whether to sync one-way or bidirectionally. Configure which fields carry over — title, description, due date, assignee, labels — between the two platforms.

howItWorks.step: GAIA automates the rest
howItWorks.description: Once configured, GAIA monitors both platforms and propagates changes automatically, keeping tasks and cards consistent so your team always works from accurate data.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync Asana subtasks to Trello checklists?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can convert Asana subtasks into Trello card checklists, preserving the hierarchical structure of your work items even though Trello's data model differs from Asana's.

faqs.question: What happens to Asana custom fields when syncing to Trello?
faqs.answer: Asana custom fields that have a Trello equivalent are mapped automatically. Fields without a direct counterpart are appended to the Trello card description so no information is lost.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for a permanent sync or just a one-time migration?
faqs.answer: Both. GAIA supports ongoing bidirectional sync for teams running both platforms in parallel, as well as one-time migration jobs for teams moving from Asana to Trello or vice versa.

asana-linear.tagline: Sync product management in Asana with engineering execution in Linear
asana-linear.metaTitle: Integração Asana + Linear: produto e engenharia conectados
asana-linear.metaDescription: Asana + Linear no GAIA: Sincronize marcos de projetos com issues e leve o progresso de volta, alinhando produto e engenharia sem reuniões de conciliação.
asana-linear.intro:
Product teams often live in Asana for its project planning capabilities while engineering teams prefer Linear for its speed and developer-centric workflow. The gap between the two creates a constant synchronization problem — product managers manually copy specs into Linear issues, engineers close Linear issues but Asana still shows tasks as open, and leadership lacks a unified view of what is shipped versus what is planned.

GAIA bridges Asana and Linear so product decisions automatically flow into engineering backlogs and engineering progress automatically surfaces in product timelines. When a product manager marks an Asana task as ready for engineering, GAIA creates the corresponding Linear issue with full context. When engineers close a Linear issue, GAIA updates the Asana task status so the product roadmap stays accurate.

This integration is built for product-engineering teams who want to keep their preferred tools while eliminating the coordination overhead that comes from running two disconnected systems.

useCases.title: Create Linear issues from Asana tasks
useCases.description: When a product manager marks an Asana task as Ready for Engineering, GAIA automatically creates a Linear issue in the appropriate team's backlog with the task title, description, and any attached specs.

useCases.title: Reflect engineering progress in product timelines
useCases.description: When a Linear issue moves to In Progress or Done, GAIA updates the corresponding Asana task status so product managers see accurate engineering progress without needing to check Linear directly.

useCases.title: Sync sprint cycles to Asana milestones
useCases.description: GAIA maps Linear sprint timelines to Asana milestone dates, giving the product team visibility into engineering cadences and ensuring release planning reflects what engineering can realistically deliver.

useCases.title: Bug escalation from Linear to Asana
useCases.description: When a high-priority bug is filed in Linear, GAIA creates a corresponding Asana task for the product team, prompting them to assess customer impact and reprioritize the roadmap if necessary.

useCases.title: Blocked issue alerts across teams
useCases.description: When a Linear issue is blocked waiting on product decisions, GAIA creates an Asana task for the responsible product manager with context and a deadline, preventing engineering from stalling silently.

howItWorks.step: Connect Asana and Linear to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Asana workspace and Linear organization. Configure which Asana projects map to which Linear teams and how statuses correspond between the two systems.

howItWorks.step: Define trigger conditions and field mappings
howItWorks.description: Set the conditions that trigger syncs — such as an Asana task reaching a specific section or a Linear issue changing state — and map fields like priority, assignee, and description between platforms.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps product and engineering aligned
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both platforms continuously and propagates changes in real time, so product managers and engineers always work from a shared, accurate understanding of project status.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync Asana project sections to Linear cycles?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can map Asana project sections to Linear cycles or projects, and update issue assignments as tasks move through your Asana workflow stages.

faqs.question: What if the same feature is tracked differently in each tool?
faqs.answer: You can define explicit mappings between Asana tasks and Linear issues by linking them manually the first time. After that, GAIA maintains the link and syncs updates automatically.

faqs.question: Does GAIA sync Linear comments back to Asana?
faqs.answer: GAIA can append a summary of Linear comment activity to the Asana task description or post it as a task comment, keeping product managers informed of engineering discussions without requiring Linear access.

asana-figma.tagline: Link Figma design deliverables directly to Asana project tasks
asana-figma.metaTitle: Integração Asana + Figma: entregas de design nas tarefas
asana-figma.metaDescription: Asana + Figma no GAIA: Anexe arquivos a tarefas e avise quando os designs estiverem prontos, acompanhando a aprovação sem sair do Asana.
asana-figma.intro:
Design and project management workflows are tightly coupled but typically tracked in separate tools. Designers work in Figma while project managers track deliverables in Asana, and the handoff between them involves manual Figma link sharing, copy-pasted feedback, and status updates communicated through Slack threads or email chains.

GAIA connects Asana and Figma so design progress and project timelines stay synchronized. When a designer marks a Figma file ready for review, GAIA can automatically update the linked Asana task and notify the relevant stakeholders. When an Asana task enters the design phase, GAIA can create a Figma file stub and link it back to the task so there is always a single source of truth for design deliverables.

This integration reduces coordination overhead between design and product teams, accelerates feedback loops, and ensures that design handoffs happen at the right stage of the project rather than after deadlines have already slipped.

useCases.title: Auto-attach Figma files to Asana tasks
useCases.description: When a new Figma file is created for a project, GAIA automatically attaches the Figma link to the corresponding Asana task so team members always know where to find the latest design assets.

useCases.title: Design-ready notifications in Asana
useCases.description: When a designer updates a Figma file to a Ready for Review status, GAIA updates the linked Asana task stage and notifies the assigned reviewer so feedback begins without a separate Slack message.

useCases.title: Track design approval status
useCases.description: GAIA monitors Figma comment activity and reflects approval or revision requests as Asana task comments, giving project managers a complete view of the design review lifecycle within their existing tool.

useCases.title: Trigger design tasks from Asana milestones
useCases.description: When an Asana milestone is reached — such as a feature spec being approved — GAIA creates the corresponding design task in Asana and initializes a Figma file, ensuring design work begins at the right moment.

useCases.title: Design handoff to development
useCases.description: When a Figma design is marked approved, GAIA transitions the Asana task to a development-ready section and notifies the engineering assignee with the Figma link, making handoffs automatic and traceable.

howItWorks.step: Connect Asana and Figma to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Asana workspace and Figma account. Configure which Asana projects correspond to which Figma teams or projects.

howItWorks.step: Map design stages to Asana task sections
howItWorks.description: Define how Figma file statuses — In Progress, Ready for Review, Approved — map to Asana task sections or custom fields so status changes flow automatically.

howItWorks.step: GAIA links design and project work
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both platforms and propagates status changes, file links, and notifications in real time, so design progress is always visible within Asana.

faqs.question: Can GAIA attach specific Figma frames rather than entire files?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to attach specific Figma frame or component links to Asana tasks, making it easier for reviewers to navigate directly to the relevant part of a complex design file.

faqs.question: Does GAIA sync Figma comments to Asana?
faqs.answer: GAIA can summarize Figma comment threads and post them as Asana task comments, giving project managers visibility into design feedback without requiring a Figma account.

faqs.question: What happens when a Figma file is updated after the design is approved?
faqs.answer: GAIA can detect Figma file edits after approval and reopen the Asana review task or notify the team, ensuring that post-approval changes are not silently deployed without another review cycle.

asana-discord.tagline: Post Asana task updates to Discord team channels automatically
asana-discord.metaTitle: Integração Asana + Discord: alertas de tarefas e marcos
asana-discord.metaDescription: Mantenha o time informado sem repassar cada tarefa. O GAIA publica tarefas concluídas e marcos do Asana no Discord e sinaliza atrasos. Veja os passos.
asana-discord.intro:
Teams that collaborate on Discord need project updates to come to them rather than requiring constant tab-switching to Asana. When task completions, new assignments, and missed deadlines live only inside Asana, Discord-first teams miss critical context and fall out of sync with project progress.

GAIA connects Asana and Discord so the project events that matter most are automatically surfaced in the right Discord channels. Task completions appear in team channels, new assignments notify individuals in DMs, and milestone achievements trigger announcements to the whole server. Teams that live in Discord can stay fully informed about Asana project health without leaving their primary communication platform.

This integration works especially well for developer communities, gaming studios, and remote-first companies that use Discord as their primary team hub and Asana for structured project management.

useCases.title: Post task completions to team channels
useCases.description: When a task is marked complete in Asana, GAIA posts a formatted update to the designated Discord channel, keeping the team informed of progress and giving completions the visibility they deserve.

useCases.title: Notify assignees of new tasks via Discord DM
useCases.description: When a task is assigned in Asana, GAIA sends a direct message to the assignee on Discord with the task title, description, due date, and a link to Asana, ensuring immediate awareness without email.

useCases.title: Announce project milestones
useCases.description: When an Asana milestone is reached, GAIA posts a milestone announcement to the relevant Discord channel or server announcement channel, giving the whole team visibility into major project achievements.

useCases.title: Overdue task alerts
useCases.description: GAIA checks Asana daily for overdue tasks and posts a digest to the project manager's Discord DM or a dedicated alerts channel, ensuring nothing slips through without notice.

useCases.title: Daily standup digest
useCases.description: Each morning GAIA posts a structured standup digest to a Discord channel listing tasks due today, tasks completed yesterday, and any blockers flagged in Asana, replacing manual standup preparation.

howItWorks.step: Connect Asana and Discord to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Asana workspace and your Discord server. Configure which Asana projects or teams map to which Discord channels.

howItWorks.step: Choose which events trigger Discord messages
howItWorks.description: Select the Asana events — task creation, assignment, completion, overdue, milestone — that should generate Discord notifications, and specify the target channel or user for each event type.

howItWorks.step: GAIA delivers real-time project updates
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Asana continuously and posts formatted notifications to Discord as events occur, keeping your team informed without anyone checking Asana manually.

faqs.question: Can I create Asana tasks from Discord messages?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can mention GAIA in a Discord message and ask it to create an Asana task with a specific title, assignee, and due date. GAIA will confirm the task creation and post the Asana link back to the channel.

faqs.question: Can GAIA post to multiple Discord channels for different Asana projects?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure per-project channel mappings so that updates from different Asana projects route to different Discord channels, keeping notifications organized and relevant.

faqs.question: Will GAIA create noise by posting every small Asana update?
faqs.answer: No. You have full control over which event types generate Discord posts. Most teams configure GAIA to post only completions, milestone events, and overdue alerts to keep channels signal-rich.

asana-drive.tagline: Attach Drive documents to Asana tasks and organize deliverables automatically
asana-drive.metaTitle: Integração Asana + Google Drive: documentos nas tarefas
asana-drive.metaDescription: Asana + Google Drive no GAIA: Anexe arquivos a tarefas e crie pastas quando projetos começarem, mantendo todas as entregas organizadas e acessíveis.
asana-drive.intro:
Project tasks in Asana rarely exist in isolation — they reference briefs, specs, reports, and deliverables stored in Google Drive. Without automation, team members spend time hunting through Drive folders for the right document, or they attach stale file versions to Asana tasks because the link was shared months ago and the file has since moved.

GAIA connects Asana and Google Drive so documents are always where you expect them. When a new Asana project launches, GAIA creates a corresponding Drive folder with the right structure. As tasks progress, GAIA attaches the relevant Drive documents automatically. When a deliverable is updated in Drive, GAIA notifies the Asana task assignee so reviews happen promptly.

This integration is essential for content teams, marketing agencies, and operations departments that rely on Google Drive as their document store and Asana as their project management layer.

useCases.title: Create Drive project folders from Asana projects
useCases.description: When a new project is created in Asana, GAIA automatically creates a structured Google Drive folder with subfolders for briefs, deliverables, and references, and attaches the folder link to the Asana project.

useCases.title: Auto-attach Drive files to Asana tasks
useCases.description: When a file is added to a project folder in Drive, GAIA attaches it to the corresponding Asana task based on naming conventions or folder structure, eliminating manual link sharing.

useCases.title: Notify assignees when deliverables are updated
useCases.description: When a Drive document linked to an Asana task is edited, GAIA posts a comment on the Asana task notifying the assignee that the file has been updated, prompting timely review.

useCases.title: Archive completed project documents
useCases.description: When an Asana project is marked complete, GAIA moves the associated Drive files to an archive folder and records the final document links in the Asana project description for future reference.

useCases.title: Generate task briefs from Drive templates
useCases.description: When an Asana task is created for a recurring deliverable type, GAIA creates a Drive document from the appropriate template, pre-fills it with task metadata, and attaches it to the task automatically.

howItWorks.step: Authorize Asana and Google Drive in GAIA
howItWorks.description: Connect your Asana workspace and Google Drive account to GAIA. Specify the root Drive folder where project folders should be created and the Asana projects to monitor.

howItWorks.step: Configure folder structure and attachment rules
howItWorks.description: Define the Drive folder template for new projects and the rules GAIA uses to match Drive files to Asana tasks — by file name pattern, subfolder, or task custom field.

howItWorks.step: GAIA manages document organization automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both Asana and Drive for changes, creating folders, attaching files, and posting notifications so your team always finds the right document attached to the right task.

faqs.question: Can GAIA attach a specific Drive file to an Asana task on demand?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ask GAIA to find a specific Drive file by name and attach it to an Asana task. GAIA searches Drive, retrieves the file, and adds the attachment to the task.

faqs.question: Does GAIA create one Drive folder per Asana project or per task?
faqs.answer: By default, GAIA creates one Drive folder per Asana project with subfolders for major task groups. You can also configure per-task document creation for high-volume or template-driven workflows.

faqs.question: What happens to Drive files if an Asana project is deleted?
faqs.answer: GAIA does not delete Drive files when an Asana project is removed. It can optionally move the files to an archive folder and log the action so documents are preserved for compliance or reference purposes.

asana-zoom.tagline: Schedule project kickoffs from Asana milestones and post Zoom summaries to tasks
asana-zoom.metaTitle: Integração Asana + Zoom: marcos do projeto e videochamadas
asana-zoom.metaDescription: Asana + Zoom no GAIA: Agende chamadas quando marcos forem atingidos, publique resumos nas tarefas e crie follow-ups sem sair da gestão de projetos.
asana-zoom.intro:
Project milestones in Asana often trigger the need for a team meeting — a kickoff call when a project launches, a review meeting when a phase completes, or a retrospective when a milestone is missed. Scheduling these meetings manually, then manually copying action items from the Zoom call back into Asana, creates friction and delays that compound across every project.

GAIA connects Asana and Zoom so project events automatically trigger the right meetings and meeting outcomes automatically flow back into project tasks. When an Asana milestone is reached, GAIA schedules the appropriate Zoom call and invites the right participants. When the call ends, GAIA posts the meeting summary and extracts action items as new Asana tasks, keeping your project moving without manual follow-up.

This integration is valuable for project managers who run recurring milestone reviews and for teams that rely on Zoom for collaboration but need meeting outcomes to live inside Asana where work actually gets tracked.

useCases.title: Auto-schedule kickoff calls from project creation
useCases.description: When a new Asana project is created, GAIA schedules a Zoom kickoff call with all project members, sends calendar invites, and attaches the meeting link to the Asana project for easy access.

useCases.title: Trigger milestone review meetings automatically
useCases.description: When an Asana milestone is marked complete, GAIA schedules a Zoom review meeting with the relevant stakeholders within a configurable window, ensuring reviews happen promptly without manual scheduling.

useCases.title: Post Zoom meeting summaries to Asana tasks
useCases.description: After a Zoom call linked to an Asana project, GAIA generates a meeting summary and posts it as a comment on the relevant Asana task or project, creating a permanent record of what was discussed.

useCases.title: Create Asana tasks from Zoom action items
useCases.description: GAIA analyzes Zoom meeting transcripts for action items and automatically creates corresponding Asana tasks with assignees, descriptions, and due dates derived from what was agreed during the call.

useCases.title: Overdue project escalation calls
useCases.description: When a project in Asana is overdue by a configurable threshold, GAIA automatically schedules an urgent Zoom call with the project manager and key stakeholders to diagnose and resolve the delay.

howItWorks.step: Connect Asana and Zoom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Asana workspace and Zoom account. Link your calendar so GAIA can schedule meetings at times that work for all participants.

howItWorks.step: Configure milestone-to-meeting triggers
howItWorks.description: Define which Asana milestones or project events should trigger Zoom meetings, who should be invited, and how soon after the milestone the meeting should be scheduled.

howItWorks.step: GAIA schedules meetings and captures outcomes
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Asana for milestone events, schedules the appropriate Zoom calls, and after each meeting posts summaries and action items back to Asana automatically.

faqs.question: Can GAIA schedule Zoom calls from Asana task comments?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mention GAIA in an Asana task comment and ask it to schedule a Zoom meeting for the task assignees. GAIA checks availability and sends calendar invites with the Zoom link.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require Zoom transcription to be enabled for meeting summaries?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zoom meeting summaries rely on Zoom's transcription feature. GAIA accesses the transcript after the meeting ends and generates a structured summary posted to the relevant Asana task.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create recurring Zoom meetings for ongoing Asana projects?
faqs.answer: Yes. For long-running projects, GAIA can schedule recurring Zoom standups or review meetings based on Asana sprint cycles or project phase timelines, with participants updated as the team changes.

asana-salesforce.tagline: Link client project tasks in Asana to Salesforce opportunities and accounts
asana-salesforce.metaTitle: Integração Asana + Salesforce: entrega de projetos e CRM
asana-salesforce.metaDescription: Asana + Salesforce no GAIA: Crie projetos a partir de oportunidades e sincronize marcos de entrega com o CRM, dando visão total da saúde do projeto.
asana-salesforce.intro:
Sales teams close deals in Salesforce while delivery teams execute projects in Asana, but the two systems rarely communicate. Account managers lack visibility into project delivery status without asking the delivery team directly. Delivery teams lack the account context that lives in Salesforce. The result is a gap between what was sold and what is being delivered, with both teams working from incomplete information.

GAIA bridges Asana and Salesforce so project delivery and client relationship management work together seamlessly. When a Salesforce opportunity closes, GAIA automatically creates an Asana project with the right structure and assigns the delivery team. As project milestones are reached, GAIA updates the Salesforce account record so account managers always know where delivery stands without interrupting the project team.

This integration is critical for professional services firms, SaaS companies with implementation teams, and agencies that need tight alignment between sales commitments and project delivery.

useCases.title: Create Asana projects from closed Salesforce opportunities
useCases.description: When a Salesforce opportunity reaches Closed Won, GAIA automatically creates a corresponding Asana project, assigns the delivery team, and populates tasks based on the contracted scope of work.

useCases.title: Sync project milestones to Salesforce account records
useCases.description: When Asana milestones are completed, GAIA updates the associated Salesforce account with delivery status notes, giving account managers real-time project health visibility inside their CRM.

useCases.title: Escalate at-risk projects to account owners
useCases.description: When a project in Asana is flagged as at-risk or significantly overdue, GAIA creates a Salesforce task for the account owner to initiate a client conversation before the relationship is affected.

useCases.title: Log delivery milestones as Salesforce activities
useCases.description: Key Asana project events — phase completions, go-live milestones, issue resolutions — are automatically logged as Salesforce activity records, building a complete client history without manual data entry.

useCases.title: Upsell triggers from project completion
useCases.description: When an Asana project is marked complete, GAIA creates a Salesforce follow-up task for the account manager to explore renewal or upsell opportunities while the client relationship is at its strongest.

howItWorks.step: Connect Asana and Salesforce to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Asana workspace and Salesforce organization. Map Salesforce opportunity fields to Asana project fields so data flows accurately between systems.

howItWorks.step: Configure triggers and account mappings
howItWorks.description: Define which Salesforce opportunity stages trigger Asana project creation, which Asana milestone events update Salesforce records, and how accounts are linked to projects.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps delivery and CRM in sync
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both platforms and propagates relevant events bidirectionally, ensuring sales and delivery teams always share an accurate, up-to-date view of each client engagement.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create different Asana project templates based on Salesforce opportunity type?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to select Asana project templates based on Salesforce fields such as product line, contract value, or opportunity type, ensuring each project starts with the right task structure.

faqs.question: How does GAIA handle Salesforce accounts with multiple active projects?
faqs.answer: GAIA links each Asana project to the specific Salesforce opportunity that generated it. Account-level summaries aggregate all linked projects so account managers see a complete delivery picture.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync Asana project budgets to Salesforce opportunity values?
faqs.answer: GAIA can read contract value from Salesforce and populate a custom Asana project field for budget tracking. Actual-versus-planned budget analysis requires connecting your financial data source as well.

trello-notion.tagline: Embed Trello boards in Notion and sync cards to Notion databases automatically
trello-notion.metaTitle: Trello + Notion Automation - Connect Boards to Your Knowledge Base
trello-notion.metaDescription: Bridge Trello and Notion with GAIA. Sync Trello cards to Notion databases, embed board status in Notion project pages, and keep your knowledge base and task management in perfect alignment.
trello-notion.intro:
Trello and Notion serve complementary purposes — Trello for visual task management and Notion for documentation, wikis, and project knowledge bases. But when teams run both, Trello cards and Notion pages diverge quickly. A Trello card gets completed but the Notion project page still shows it as in progress. A Notion database entry is created but no Trello card exists to track the actual work.

GAIA connects Trello and Notion so task management and documentation stay aligned. Trello card updates flow into Notion database entries, Notion project pages pull live Trello board status, and new Notion items trigger Trello card creation. Teams get the visual workflow benefits of Trello with the rich documentation capabilities of Notion, connected rather than siloed.

This integration is ideal for teams that use Notion as their company wiki while managing day-to-day tasks in Trello, and for project managers who need project documentation and task status to live in the same place.

useCases.title: Sync Trello cards to a Notion database
useCases.description: When a card is added to a Trello board, GAIA creates a corresponding entry in a Notion database with the card title, description, due date, and list status, keeping documentation in sync with execution.

useCases.title: Update Notion entries when Trello cards move
useCases.description: When a Trello card moves between lists — from Backlog to In Progress to Done — GAIA updates the status field on the linked Notion database entry, keeping the Notion project database accurate.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from Notion database entries
useCases.description: When a new task is added to a Notion project database, GAIA creates the corresponding Trello card in the right list, ensuring every documented task has an actionable card for execution.

useCases.title: Embed Trello board summaries in Notion project pages
useCases.description: GAIA generates a structured Trello board status summary and appends it to the linked Notion project page on a scheduled basis, giving readers an accurate view of task progress without leaving Notion.

useCases.title: Archive completed cards to Notion
useCases.description: When a Trello card is completed and archived, GAIA appends a completion record to the Notion project page, building a running log of completed work that serves as project history and documentation.

howItWorks.step: Connect Trello and Notion to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Trello boards and your Notion workspace. Map specific Trello boards to Notion databases and define which fields correspond between the two platforms.

howItWorks.step: Set sync direction and trigger events
howItWorks.description: Choose whether to sync from Trello to Notion, Notion to Trello, or both. Configure which card events — creation, list movement, due date change, completion — trigger Notion updates.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps boards and databases aligned
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both platforms and propagates changes automatically so your Trello boards and Notion databases always reflect the same task state without manual data entry.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync Trello card labels to Notion tags?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA maps Trello card labels to Notion multi-select or tag fields. When a label is added or removed from a Trello card, GAIA updates the corresponding Notion entry field to match.

faqs.question: What happens to Notion entries when Trello cards are deleted?
faqs.answer: By default, GAIA marks the Notion entry as archived rather than deleting it, preserving project history. You can configure GAIA to delete entries instead if your workflow requires a clean database.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create a Trello board from a Notion project template?
faqs.answer: Yes. When a new project page is created in Notion from a template, GAIA can read the task list from the template and create a fully structured Trello board with lists and initial cards automatically.

trello-slack.tagline: Post Trello card updates to Slack and create cards directly from Slack messages
trello-slack.metaTitle: Trello + Slack Automation - Real-Time Board Updates in Slack
trello-slack.metaDescription: Connect Trello and Slack with GAIA. Get notified in Slack when Trello cards move, create new cards from Slack messages, and keep your team aligned without switching between tools.
trello-slack.intro:
Trello boards track work visually but only for people who are actively watching them. Team members in Slack miss card movements, due date changes, and completion events unless they check Trello directly. Conversely, important tasks discussed and agreed upon in Slack never make it into Trello because someone always has to manually create the card.

GAIA connects Trello and Slack so neither side has to change their habits. Trello events surface automatically in the right Slack channels, and tasks identified in Slack are captured in Trello without requiring anyone to leave the conversation. Teams that live in Slack stay informed about project progress, and tasks discussed in chat become trackable cards automatically.

This integration is particularly valuable for agile teams running sprints in Trello, customer support teams routing issues through Slack, and remote teams who use Slack as their digital office and Trello as their project board.

useCases.title: Post card completion updates to Slack channels
useCases.description: When a Trello card moves to the Done list, GAIA posts a formatted update to the designated Slack channel, celebrating progress and keeping the team informed without anyone checking the board manually.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from Slack messages
useCases.description: When a task is identified in a Slack message, mention GAIA or react with a specific emoji and GAIA will create a Trello card from the message content, assign it to the right person, and confirm creation in the thread.

useCases.title: Daily board digest in Slack
useCases.description: GAIA posts a morning digest to a Slack channel listing all Trello cards due today, cards moved yesterday, and any overdue items, giving the team a quick project health snapshot without opening Trello.

useCases.title: Overdue card alerts
useCases.description: When a Trello card passes its due date without being completed, GAIA sends a Slack DM to the card's assigned member and a summary alert to the project channel so nothing slips through unnoticed.

useCases.title: New card assignment notifications
useCases.description: When a Trello card is assigned to a team member, GAIA sends them a Slack DM with the card title, description, due date, and board link, ensuring immediate awareness of new responsibilities.

howItWorks.step: Connect Trello and Slack to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Trello boards and your Slack workspace. Map Trello boards to Slack channels so updates from each board route to the appropriate team channel.

howItWorks.step: Configure which events post to Slack
howItWorks.description: Choose the Trello events that trigger Slack messages — card creation, movement between lists, due date arrival, completion, or assignment — and set the target channel for each event type.

howItWorks.step: GAIA bridges boards and chat in real time
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Trello for board activity and posts structured notifications to Slack as events occur, while also listening in Slack for card creation requests so tasks move from conversation to execution instantly.

faqs.question: Can GAIA post different Trello boards to different Slack channels?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure per-board Slack channel mappings so that updates from your marketing board go to the marketing channel, engineering board updates go to the engineering channel, and so on.

faqs.question: What format do Slack notifications from Trello take?
faqs.answer: GAIA posts structured Slack messages with the card title, current list, assignee, due date, and a direct link to the Trello card. Digest messages include a formatted table of cards grouped by status.

faqs.question: Can I create a Trello card from a Slack message without a bot command?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA supports emoji-based card creation — react to any Slack message with a designated emoji and GAIA will create a Trello card from that message automatically.

trello-github.tagline: Move Trello cards when PRs merge and link GitHub issues to Trello cards
trello-github.metaTitle: Trello + GitHub Automation - Connect Code Delivery to Project Boards
trello-github.metaDescription: Link your GitHub development workflow to Trello with GAIA. Automatically move Trello cards when pull requests merge, create cards from GitHub issues, and keep engineering and project management perfectly aligned.
trello-github.intro:
Software teams using Trello for project management and GitHub for code often face a visibility gap — Trello cards sit in In Progress long after the code has merged, and GitHub issues get filed without corresponding Trello cards for the product team to track. The disconnect means project status in Trello rarely reflects the actual state of development in GitHub.

GAIA connects Trello and GitHub so code events automatically update project boards and project cards trigger appropriate GitHub actions. When a pull request is merged, GAIA moves the linked Trello card to Done. When a GitHub issue is opened, GAIA can create the corresponding Trello card. The result is a Trello board that stays accurate without requiring engineers to manually update cards after every commit.

This integration is essential for small-to-medium development teams that use Trello for product planning and GitHub for all code activity, and for teams that need non-technical stakeholders to have accurate project visibility without access to GitHub.

useCases.title: Move Trello cards when pull requests merge
